result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example, but the full `mvn -o test` run passes.

The change is in `DataStore.findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 5276). It now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()`, the same ordering the sales rep's list uses. I updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are still filtered out as before.

Only the region overview calls this method, so nothing else changes order.
